name: CHOM Burger "Lil Chom" Single Cheddar Smashburger & Plain Fries
brandOrRestaurant: CHOM Burger (Orem / Provo / South Jordan / Cottonwood Heights, UT)
whyItWorks: The "Lil Chom" single-patty burger on CHOM's soft house-baked potato bun gives you a right-sized portion of antibiotic-free beef and melted cheddar without the heavy grease of a double burger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the "Lil Chom" Burger with cheddar cheese only on the potato bun (no lettuce, tomato, raw onion, pickles, or CHOM sauce) and pair with a small plain French fries.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy Jalapeño Chom, Guacamole Bacon Burger, and garlic-herb fries
